description:
Attachments not syncing to Outlook365 Drafts using 'Draft Email' action in Workflow

## Bug Description

I am trying to create draft using workflow using 'Draft Email' action. The attachments are not being posted with the draft to Outlook365 email draft. email body, cc, bbc area all syncing and working file, it's just the attachments that won't show. 
On a side note, 'send email' action is flawlessly sending attachment with email. 


Do note that I am behind Cloudflare and nginx.
